attempts.summary: Configured and verified `inventory-worker` on node1. It runs as the dedicated unprivileged `inventorysvc` account inside a root-owned, read-only chroot; `/var/lib/inventory` is its only writable application directory. The service is enabled, survived a full node reboot, retained its data, and resumed writing heartbeats. Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic remain unchanged.
